rebecca: Heads-up: regional maintenance + short SLO adjustment Sat 2026-06-12 01:30-03:00 UTC. We'll perform control-plane rolling updates in eu-west-1 and a small routing rebalance. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/eu-west-maint (internal). Please ACK if you have traffic that must be pinned. :loud_sound:
dan: Ack. Which services are in the initial canary?
rebecca: Canary: internal-dev, beta, control-prod-2pct. Routes: /v1/generate-small, /v1/rerank. Expect brief p95 spikes during leader election and KV warmup.
ops-eng: Embeddings excluded; we will not touch embed-* pools. Quiet window 01:15-03:30 UTC.
sre_oncall: Status blurb draft: "Planned maintenance in eu-west-1 may cause intermittent increased latency on affected routes. No customer data loss expected."
carlos: Rollback criteria?
rebecca: Abort if sustained 5xx > 1% for 10m OR p99 for high-priority routes > 1.2s for 5m. Post-checks: KV hit-rate >= 90% within 12m, error budget burn < 1.5x.
deploy-bot: Job scheduled: eu-west-maint-2701234567. Pre-checks passed.
ops-eng: We'll pre-warm KV prefixes 20m prior and enable temporary circuit-break guards.
dan: I'll watch canary dashboards and own rollback. Ping me in #oncall if any trigger.
sre_oncall: Rota updated and dedicated channel #eu-west-maint-2701234567 created.
rebecca: Final reminder Fri 12:00 PT. Post-mortem within 48h. If you need exclusions, add them before Thu EOD.
